Assay abbreviation-to-code mapping

Source: R/data.R
ASSAY_ABBREV_TO_CODE.Rd

Values are codes and names are abbreviations ASSAY_ABBREV. See MotrpacBicQC::assay_codes for more details.

Usage

ASSAY_ABBREV_TO_CODE

Format

Named character vector
